solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Organise rescue — fast

indicators.note: to organise is to put in order, so the letters of the next word are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: An order to set up a rescue operation quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like an adverb urging speed, but it is the definition: fast as in firmly fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something held fast is firmly fixed, the same sense as tied or locked in place.

clue.text: Drop out at university and prepare for the theatre

parts.note: to scrub something out is to drop or cancel it
up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: A student quits college and gets ready for the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' suggests the stage, but it is the operating theatre, where surgeons wash first.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons wash hands and arms thoroughly before operating, the meaning of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Combined to make notes about it

indicators.note: about places the first word around the second

parts.note: to compose is to write music, making notes

explanation.surface: Working together to jot down notes on it.
explanation.definitionFit: Composite means made up of several parts joined together.

clue.text: Don't follow suit

parts.note: looks like advice not to copy others, but in card games failing to play the led suit has its own term

explanation.surface: Advice not to copy everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge and whist, playing another card when able to follow the led suit is this offence.

clue.text: Called into action, totally without reason

indicators.note: into places the word for called inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action
called on the telephone means rang

explanation.surface: Someone summoned to act goes completely mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Deranged describes a mind that has lost all reason, a synonym for insane.

clue.text: Key study provided by former PM

parts.note: E is a musical key
a den is a study or private room

explanation.surface: A vital piece of research funded by an ex-premier.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony EDEN was British Prime Minister in 1955-57.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Eden was Britain's Prime Minister from 1955 to 1957.

clue.text: The summary is merely theoretical

definitions.meaning: a summary of a paper is its brief précis
not concrete, existing only as an idea

explanation.surface: Criticism that a précis is all theory.
explanation.definitionFit: An academic paper's precis is so named; the adjective means conceptual rather than concrete.

clue.text: Famous film actress seen in the dress circle

parts.note: garb is dress or clothing
O is circular in shape

explanation.surface: A star spotted in the theatre's dress circle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen in the dress circle' looks like a hidden-word signal but the pieces come from synonyms. Greta GARBO was a Swedish-born Hollywood star.
explanation.definitionFit: Greta Garbo was a Swedish-born Hollywood screen star of the 1920s and 30s.

clue.text: Justify rate

definitions.meaning: to warrant or merit, so an action is justified
to rate something is to be worthy of it, to merit it

explanation.surface: A demand to explain a valuation.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean to merit or be worthy of something, as a reward does.

clue.text: Take away or put back on the agenda?

definitions.meaning: to take away is to shift something off
to move a motion again, read as ..., a punning sense

explanation.surface: A committee wonders whether to drop an item or table it once more.
explanation.definitionFit: The plain sense is a synonym for take off; the second splits the word as a prefix plus move, propose again.

clue.text: Steps taken in dances

definitions.meaning: actions taken to deal with something
in older usage a measure is a stately dance

explanation.surface: Footwork practised in the ballroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Government action is described as measures; a measure was also a formal dance in Tudor times.

clue.text: House rule

definitions.meaning: a royal house, a ruling family line
a period of rule by one family

explanation.surface: A household regulation.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal family line is called a house, and its reign over generations is the same word.

clue.text: Put up with a girl in New York

parts.note: to brook something is to tolerate it
Lyn is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Tolerating a young woman while living in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Brooklyn is one of the five boroughs of New York City, so it is a place found there.

clue.text: Rigid habit of old king caught in affair

indicators.note: caught in puts the abbreviation for king within the word for affair

parts.note: an amour is a love affair
R stands for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: An old king's inflexible routine exposed in a scandalous liaison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' suggests a custom, but here it means clothing, as a monk's habit is.
explanation.definitionFit: Metal plate worn by knights was stiff protective clothing from earlier times, a habit in the sense of garment.

clue.text: Finance record reveals arrears

parts.note: to back a venture is to finance it
a log is a record

explanation.surface: An accounts ledger shows overdue debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Accumulated undone work or unpaid orders that have built up, like arrears.

clue.text: Quiet, on edge and rather demure

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: A quiet, edgy person who seems reserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Prim means stiffly proper and modest, close to demure in a slightly prudish way.

clue.text: Outstanding figure in the financial world

definitions.text: Outstanding figure in the financial world

parts.words: Outstanding figure in the financial world
parts.note: reads like a celebrated banker, but outstanding means unpaid and figure means a sum

explanation.surface: A celebrated personality of the City.
explanation.definitionFit: The amount still owed on an account is an unpaid sum, outstanding in the accounting sense.

clue.text: The way of management

definitions.meaning: a route or course to follow
the guidance or control given by managers

explanation.surface: Explaining how managers operate.
explanation.definitionFit: A heading or route taken; also the guidance and supervision of an organisation.

clue.text: Dad turns up with Mum perhaps, that's obvious

indicators.note: turns up, in a down entry, reads the word for dad from bottom to top

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for dad
a mum is an example of a parent

explanation.surface: Father arrives with Mother, clearly.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparent means clearly visible or evident, a synonym of obvious.

clue.text: Chimney cleaners accept a gamble

parts.note: chimney sweeps clean flues
to take is to accept

explanation.surface: Sweeps take a punt on a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweepstake is a lottery-style bet where all stakes go to the winners, a form of gambling.

clue.text: Intervenes with measure to confront evil

parts.note: a step is a measure taken
sin is evil

explanation.surface: Someone takes action to face down wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: To step in is to intervene, getting involved in a situation.

clue.text: A student is after an alternative exam

indicators.note: is after places the letters for a student behind the word for alternative

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
L is a learner, the plate on a student driver's car

explanation.surface: A student is looking for a different test.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoken test, such as a language viva, is called an oral.

clue.text: Empty hotels converted in African kingdom

indicators.note: converted means the word hotels is changed into a new form

parts.note: O, zero, stands for empty or nothing

explanation.surface: Vacant hotels renovated in an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a mountainous kingdom wholly surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Guarantee a number finish with a painful expression

indicators.note: finish with puts the cry of pain at the end of the answer

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
ouch is a cry of pain

explanation.surface: A pledge that a figure ends with a cry of pain.
explanation.definitionFit: To avouch is to affirm or vouch for something, giving a guarantee.

clue.text: Former star played walk-on parts

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: played suggests the word star is performed in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A one-time celebrity reduced to bit parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Film extras are background performers with tiny non-speaking roles.

clue.text: Put on new presentation, reaching 100 mph

indicators.note: a new presentation of put on shows its letters in a different order

explanation.surface: A show staged afresh, going at a hundred miles an hour.
explanation.walkthrough: A TON-UP is British slang for doing 100 mph, as motorbike riders boasted.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang where a ton is a hundred, so this describes motorcycling at 100 mph.

clue.text: They have time to finish

parts.note: sounds like people with leisure to complete a job, but time means a prison sentence to serve out

explanation.surface: People who can get the job done without rushing.
explanation.definitionFit: Prisoners serving sentences have a term of time to complete before release.

clue.text: Performs after John

definitions.meaning: in the New Testament the book that follows the Gospel of John

explanation.surface: Someone appears on stage after John.
explanation.definitionFit: Performs means does things; the Acts of the Apostles follows John's Gospel in the Bible.

clue.text: Condemn complete grammatical structure

definitions.meaning: a judge condemns a guilty person to a punishment
a full set of words with subject and verb

explanation.surface: Damning a whole piece of syntax.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge passing punishment is condemning; a full grammatical unit of words is the second meaning.

clue.text: Question a unit perhaps, being curious

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the words a unit might be rearranged

explanation.surface: Questioning whether some unit is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Quaint means attractively old-fashioned or odd, a synonym of curious.

clue.text: Points me out as example of relative favouritism

indicators.note: out means the letters of points me are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone singles me out as a case of favouring family.
explanation.definitionFit: Nepotism is favouring one's family members, for example in giving jobs.

clue.text: Very occupied by intimate Japanese cult

indicators.note: occupied by means the word for very holds the verb for intimate

parts.note: so means very, as in so good
to intimate is to hint

explanation.surface: A very close Japanese religious group.
explanation.definitionFit: Shinto is the native religion of Japan, with shrines and spirit worship.
